### New in 1.3.1
- **Cleaner Welcome Screen**: Removed the static email input box from the onboarding screen in favor of a clean, prominent **Continue with Google** button.
- **Google Sign-In Dialog**: Tapping "Continue with Google" opens an interactive modal to enter your Google email with instant `@gmail.com` completion.
- **Signed-in Account Card**: Clearly displays your connected Google account details with an option to change accounts anytime.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it. It installs over older versions and keeps everything.
